learn_family_differences: Learn about the differences between fragrance families
maximum_two_families_message: You can choose up to two families. Deselect one to add another.
fragrance_families_description: Simple examples to help you imagine each profile and choose what suits your taste.
discover_your_preferred_scents: Let's discover the scents you prefer
choose_up_to_two_families: Choose one or up to two fragrance families, and I'll help you understand the difference between them.
question_1_text: What profile do you prefer for your fragrance?
question_1_note: Choose the profile you prefer, regardless of your gender.
question_2_note: Your answer helps us suggest a fragrance profile that suits you.
question_3_text: When do you usually wear fragrance?
question_3_note: Choose the time closest to when you use it.
question_4_text: In which season do you usually wear fragrance?
question_4_note: Choose the season closest to when you use it.
question_5_note: Choose one or up to two fragrance families.
question_6_text: Are there any scents you prefer to avoid?
question_6_note: Choose the scents you prefer to avoid, or skip this question.
question_7_text: What occasion do you usually wear fragrance for?
question_7_note: Choose the main use for the fragrance.
question_7_option_1: Daily use for work or study
question_7_option_4: A romantic date or quiet dinner
question_8_text: Which style is closest to your personality?
question_8_note: Choose the style closest to your personality.
question_9_text: What level of fragrance projection do you prefer?
question_9_note: Choose how far you want your fragrance to project around you.
question_9_option_1_subtitle: Only people close to you will notice it.
question_9_option_2_subtitle: A noticeable scent without being overpowering.
question_9_option_3_subtitle: Leaves a clear impression in the space.
family_1_description: Lemon and bergamot; a bright, refreshing feeling.
family_2_description: Soft and clean; scents reminiscent of cotton and powder.
family_3_description: Rose and jasmine; floral scents ranging from light to rich.
family_4_description: Apple, berries, and peach; a rich fruity profile.
family_6_description: Cedar and sandalwood; a dry or soft woody feeling.
family_7_description: Amber and spices; a warm, rich profile.
family_8_description: Oud, incense, and leather; a deep, smoky profile.
